_note: LOG-161 feat.pillar: the Pillar of Shame's roster (content/bugs.json, hand-edited). status: fixed = 已伏法, open = 在逃, watch = 保釋觀察中 (fixed, awaiting real-device confirmation). where: desktop | phone | both. Humour is the point; never mention easter eggs here.

title.zh: 一行註解吞掉整個網站
title.en: One comment ate the whole site

desc.zh: 一個行內註解把後面的程式碼全數吃掉，壞掉的版本曾短暫上線。判決：部署前檢查沒串起來，連坐。
desc.en: An inline comment swallowed the code after it and a broken build went live for a while. Verdict: the pre-deploy checks were not chained, so they hang together.

desc.zh: 同一種註解、同一行、同一種吃法，這次吃掉的是變數宣告。累犯。
desc.en: Same comment, same line, same appetite; this time it ate a variable declaration. Repeat offender.

desc.zh: 手機開段落播放器時二十個音檔同時解碼，解碼器直接躺平。改成排隊進場。
desc.en: Opening the section player decoded twenty audio files at once and the decoder lay down on the job. They queue up now.

title.zh: 拖進度條，瀑布跟音樂各走各的
title.en: Drag the seek bar and the waterfall goes its own way

desc.zh: mp3 缺了標頭，瀏覽器只能用位元率猜位置，猜得很有創意。素材補標頭結案。
desc.en: The mp3s had no header, so the browser guessed positions from the bitrate, creatively. Headers added, case closed.

title.zh: 頻譜基準線越飄越高，然後不見了
title.en: The spectrum baseline drifted up and out of frame

desc.zh: 手機比例算出負數，每一幀都往上疊一點，疊到離家出走。
desc.en: A phone ratio came out negative and every frame nudged it upward until it left home.

title.zh: 手機裡開出另一支手機
title.en: A phone opened inside the phone

desc.zh: 展示頁裡的連結沒有指定跳出去，於是在殼裡再套一層殼。俄羅斯娃娃罪。
desc.en: A link inside a demo did not say where to open, so it opened the shell inside the shell. Matryoshka offence.

title.zh: 舞台上按下一首，背景音樂也來湊熱鬧
title.en: Press next on stage and the background music joins in

desc.zh: 上一首／下一首鍵沒問「現在是誰在放音樂」，兩路一起出聲。已教它先問。
desc.en: Prev/next never asked who was holding the audio, so both played at once. It asks now.

title.zh: 手機開電腦版，版面自由發揮
title.en: Desktop mode on a phone: the layout freestyles

desc.zh: 桌面殼在手機寬度沒有適配。入口先收進「尋找」裡（打「電腦版」），本體仍在逃。
desc.en: The desktop shell has no phone-width layout. The entrance is tucked into Search (type 'desktop'); the culprit itself is still at large.

title.zh: Safari 的音量倒影偶爾整片變白
title.en: Safari's volume reflection sometimes goes solid white

desc.zh: Mac Safari 開段落播放器，右側倒影偶爾變成一塊不透明白色。疑似 canvas 疊遮罩的合成問題，尚未抓到現行犯。
desc.en: On Mac Safari the right-hand reflection in the section player occasionally turns opaque white. Suspected canvas-plus-mask compositing; not caught in the act yet.

title.zh: 字母換段時畫面頓一下
title.en: The frame hitches when the letters change section

desc.zh: 預先烘焙的圖像排在畫面幀裡做，改到閒置時段去做。
desc.en: Pre-baked images were built inside the frame; they are built in idle time now.

title.zh: 排好下一段，卻永遠重複這一段
title.en: Queued the next section, got this one forever

desc.zh: 漏了一個 null 檢查，後面的音檔全部解碼失敗，只剩第一段陪你。只在慢連線發作，潛伏多日。
desc.en: A missing null check made every later file fail to decode, leaving the first section to keep you company. Only on slow connections; it hid for days.

title.zh: 殘影該慢慢淡出，卻突然人間蒸發
title.en: The afterglow should fade, instead it vanished

desc.zh: 手機瀏覽器的光暈模糊不理會透明度，改成先畫成一張圖再淡出。
desc.en: The phone browser's glow blur ignored opacity; it is drawn to an offscreen image first and faded as a whole now.

title.zh: iPhone 載入完，開場音樂不肯開口
title.en: iPhone loaded, the opening music would not speak

desc.zh: AudioContext 建立時機錯過手勢允許的一秒窗口。改成手勢當下就建。
desc.en: The AudioContext was created after the one-second gesture window closed. It is created on the gesture now.

title.zh: 橫向拿手機，dock 被切掉還滑不到
title.en: Landscape phone: the dock was cut off and unreachable

desc.zh: 首頁內容比橫向螢幕高，又不准捲動。橫向版面另外壓縮。
desc.en: The home screen was taller than a landscape viewport and refused to scroll. Landscape gets its own compact layout.

title.zh: 曲名被同色頻譜條蓋住
title.en: The track title hid behind same-coloured bars

desc.zh: 漸層染色的文字，陰影加在字上面而不是字後面，改了三輪。最後判決：字後面壓一層襯底，字不加陰影。
desc.en: Gradient-filled text puts its shadow on top of the letters, not behind; three rounds later the verdict was a backing plate and no shadow at all.

desc.zh: 音訊元件在音訊環境就緒前搶先出聲。已修，等真機複驗後才准出獄。
desc.en: An audio element spoke before the audio context was ready. Fixed, released on bail pending real-device confirmation.
